<entry id="T01104">
<head-word>רִשְׁעָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) same, 
<italic>wickedness, guilt, indictable offense</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 21
<sup>a</sup> איש חכם לר' ‘a wise man’ (II Sam. XIII, 3) wise for wickedness. Koh. R. to III, 18 כל העובר … מדת רִשְׁעָתוֹ וכ' when one commits a sin shortly before his death, it is as if the measure of his wickedness wanted only this sin, and he completed it; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. (fr. רִשְׁעוּת</plural-form>) רִשְׁעִיּוֹת. Keth. 37
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. (ref. to Deut. XXV, 2) משום רשעה אחת … שתי ר' thou must punish him for one wrong, but not for two, i.e. not condemn him to corporal punishment and pecuniary restitution for the same act. 
<pgbrk id="pg1502" />Y. Ter. VII, beg. 44
<sup>c</sup>; Y. Keth. III, 27
<sup>b</sup> top במי שיש בו שתי ר' וכ' the text (Deut. l. c.) speaks of one against whom there are two indictments (one criminal and one pecuniary). Snh. 105
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to רשעתים, Jud. III, 8) דעבד שתי ר' וכ' he did Israel two wrongs; Tanḥ. D’barim 3, v. רָשַׁע; a. fr.—[Snh. 112
<sup>a</sup> דרשעיות, read: דרַשְׁעָנִיּוֹת.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<definition> רשף

<italic>reshef</italic> means demons (of the hot season, v. קֶטֶב); ib. אין ר' אלא יסורין

<plural-form>Pl. רְשָׁפִים</plural-form>. Midr. Till. to Ps. II וכמה ר' וברקים וכ' and how many flames, lightnings, and torches have I!; a. e.</notes></sense>

<notes>—

<entry id="T01122">
<head-word>רָתַח</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. רתע)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to bubble, boil, be hot</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—Part. רוֹתֵחַ; f. רוֹתַחַת; 
<plural-form>pl. רוֹתְחִים, רוֹתְחִין; רוֹתְחוֹת</plural-form>. [Tradit. pronunc. רוּתָח adj.] Y. Sot. IX, 24
<sup>a</sup> חלב ר' milk fresh from the goat. Y. Pes. VII, beg. 34
<sup>a</sup> והרי הוא ר' ומרתיח but is not the iron spit hot and does is not impart heat (to the lamb on it)? Bab. ib. 76
<sup>a</sup> סולת ר' heated flour. Ib. 94
<sup>b</sup> כל העולם כולו ר' וכ' (in the summer) the whole world is hot, and the springs are cold; כל … מעיינות ר' (in the winter) the whole world is cold, and the springs are hot; a. fr.—Esp. רוֹתְחִין 
<italic>hot water</italic>. Snh. 108
<sup>b</sup>; R. Hash. 12
<sup>a</sup>, v. קִלְקֵל. Y. Ber. II, 5
<sup>b</sup> bot., v. כָּוָה. Deut. R. s. 3 כשתראה אותי נותן ר' וכ' when thou seest me put hot water (to the wine), put thou cold water in &c., i.e. when I am angry, appease thou me &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִרְתִּיחַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause bubbling, foaming</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. 61
<sup>b</sup> ובמשורה שלא יַרְתִּיחַ ‘and in liquid measure’ (Lev. XIX, 35) one is warned that one must not make the liquid foam; B. Bath. 89
<sup>b</sup>; Tosef. ib. V, 5 אין … לא להַרְתִּיחַ … ולא להקפיצה (Var. להרתיע) the storekeeper is not permitted to make the liquid bubble in the measure, or to make it bound.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to heat</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Yoma I, 20 עששיות … היו מַרְתִּיחִין וכ' they heated &c.; (Yoma 34
<sup>b</sup> מחמין); v. עֲשָׁשִׁית. Y. B. Bath II, beg. 13
<sup>b</sup> הסלעים מרתיחין the rocks give out heat; Y. Sabb. IV, 6
<sup>b</sup> bot. Cant. R. to II, 17 עד שאַרְתִּיחַ היום until I shall make the day hot (for Israel’s enemies); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to grow hot</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Pes. V, 8 אינו מַרְתִּיחַ does not get hot, v. שָׂרַף I. Gen. R. s. 67 התחילו … מרתיחים (not מרתיתים) the walls of the house began to be hot; Yalk. ib. 115. Esth. R. to I, 1 (playon אר̇ת̇ח̇ש̇ש̇ת̇א) שהיה מר̇ת̇יח̇ ות̇ש̇ he used to be hot (angry), and weaken (relent) again. Cant. R. to IV, 5 two families אחת מיקרת ואחת מַרְתַּחַת one of which was cold-blooded, and the other hot-blooded; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>רִיתֵּחַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to heat, boil</italic>.</definition>
<notes> [Yalk. Gen. 27 רי' עליו, v. רָתָה]—Part. pass. מְרוּתָּח, 
<plural-form>pl. מְרוּתָּחִין</plural-form>. Lev. R. s. 14 מיעיה של אשה מר' וכ' the inner parts of woman are hot &c. Sabb. III, 5; Pes. 40
<sup>b</sup>; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="T01123">
<head-word>רְתַח</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>to boil, be hot</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—Part. pass. רָתִיחַ; 
<plural-form>pl. רְתִיחִין</plural-form>. Targ. Y. I Gen. L, 1 חמרין רתי' (some ed. רָתְחִין). Targ. Job XXIV, 24 Ms.—Y. Pes. III, 30
<sup>a</sup> top דלא יִרְתְּחָן ויחמען that they may not get hot and ferment. Ber. 62
<sup>b</sup> עד דרַתְחָא וכ', v. קִדְרָא; a. e.—רָתְחִין 
<italic>hot water</italic>. Ex. R. s. 45 מזגין ר' (not רתחים), v. מְזַג; Midr. Till. to Ps. XXV, 4.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to be excited, wroth</italic>. Targ. Ps. XXXIX, 4. Targ. Y. Deut. XIX, 6. Targ. Koh. VII, 9; a. fr.—Ber. 7
<sup>a</sup> רגע ר' for a moment the Lord is wroth. Ib. 29
<sup>b</sup> לא תִרְתַּח ולא תחטי be not excited, and thou shalt not sin. Zeb. 30
<sup>b</sup> hot. אם כן מִרְתַּח ר' if so, he might get angry; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַרְתַּח, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>רַתַּח</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to boil; to heat, excite, arouse the </italic>
<pgbrk id="pg1503" />
<italic>anger of</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Job XLI, 23 מַרְתַּח (some ed. מְרַתַּח 
<italic>Pa.</italic>). Targ. Koh. l. c. מסרב ומַרְתַּח (ed. Vien. ומִרְ', corr. acc.; some ed. ומְרַתַּח).—[Targ. Job IV, 10 מרתיחין, v. רְתַת.]—Pes. 76
<sup>a</sup> רוטב מַרְתַּח ליה וכ' (or מְרַתַּח) the juice (dripping) heats the clay (of the oven) &c. Taan. 4
<sup>a</sup> ההוא … דקא מַרְתְּחָא ליה (or מְרַתְּחָא) if a student gets angry, it is the (zeal for) the Law that excites him; a. e.—Part. pass. 
<italic>Pa.</italic> מְרַתַּח; f. מְרַתְּחָא. Targ. Y. I Lev. VI, 14 מְרֻתְּחָא (Hebraism; h. text מרבכת).—Gitt. 57
<sup>b</sup> אשכחיה … מר' וסליק he found the blood of Zechariah bubbling and coming up; (Snh. 96
<sup>b</sup> דהוה קא רתח).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<head-word>רְתַחְתָּה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced. wds.) 
<italic>boiling pot</italic>; מעשה ר' a cooked dish.</definition>

<sup>d</sup> ונִרְתַּעְתִּי לאחוריי I started back (was astonished); (Tosef. ib. I, 15 נבעתתי ונפלתי); Bab. ib. 22
<sup>b</sup> ונרתעתי ונפלתי (Ms. M. 2 והתרעתי, read: והִרְתַּעְתִּי 
<italic>Hif.</italic>); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>

<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> same. Y. Ber. III, 6 same.</definition>

<sup>d</sup> bot. וה' מלפניו כמַרְתִּיעַ וכ' and he shrank back from it, as one shrinks from a serpent. Num. R. s. 12

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>

<italic>to be excited</italic>; (of a serpent) 
<italic>to hiss</italic>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup> bot. אבל היה מרתיע ובא כנגדו but if the serpent comes against him in 
<pgbrk id="pg1504" />excitement, opp. כרוך; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to frighten away</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 55
<sup>b</sup> (play on פ̇ח̇ז̇, Gen. XLIX, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>4)</number>
<definition />
<notes> ז̇עזעתה הִירְ֗תַּעְתָּהּ פ̇רח̇ה וכ' thou didst scare her, thou didst frighten her away, and sin flew from thee.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to knock</italic>.</definition>

<sup>d</sup> bot. בא וה' על פתחו וכ' (not והרחיק) came and knocked at the king’s door. Ex. R. s. 33 (ref. to Cant. V, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition> אני ישנה … והקב"ה מַרְתִּיק עליו (not עלי) ‘I (Israel) was asleep’ after making the golden calf, but ‘my heart awoke’, when the Lord knocked at it, … ‘open unto me &c.’ Ib.</definition>

<italic>to shake the fist at, to rebel</italic>. Gen. R. s. 45 כל מי שה' אחר מדת הדין וכ' whosoever rebelled against divine justice, did not come out unscathed from under its hands.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<entry id="U00078">
<head-word>שָׁבוּעַ</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> שֶׁבַע)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>a period of seven days, week</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—שְׁבוּעַ הַבֵּן, v. בֵּן.—
<plural-form>Pl. שָׁבוּעוֹת</plural-form>. Lev. R. s. 28 שבע ש' שבין וכ' the seven weeks between Passover and the Feast of Weeks; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> “
<italic>year-week</italic>”,
<italic> a period of seven years, septennate</italic> (the jubilee being divided into seven septennates); also 
<italic>the seventh year, Sabbatical year</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. V, 1, v. חֲקִירָה. Gitt. 77
<sup>a</sup> לאחר ש' שנה if a person says, ‘give my wife a letter of divorce (or to his wife, ‘be thou divorced’), if I do not come back after the septennate’, we must wait one year (after the Sabbatical year). Ned. VIII, 1 ש' זה אסור בכל הש' וכ' (not השבועה) if a person, during a Sabbatical year, vows abstinence, using the word ‘this 
<italic>shabu‘a</italic>ʾ, he is bound the entire coming septennial period and the seventh year of the expiring Sabbatical period. Ib. ש' אחד אסור וכ' but if he says, ‘one septennate’, he is bound from date to date, i.e. counting seven years from the day of the vow; a. fr.—
<italic>Pl.</italic> as ab. Y. Sabb. X, 17
<sup>a</sup> top אי אפשר לשני ש' שלא חל וכ' it is not possible that during fourteen years the fourteenth day of Nisan should not occur on a Sabbath; Y. Pes. VI, 33
<sup>a</sup> bot. לשני שביעית שיחול (corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U00081">
<head-word>שְׁבוּעָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> שָׁבַע)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>oath</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Shebu. III, 1 ש' שאוכל וכ' if he says, I swear that I will eat, or, that I shall not eat &c. Ib. 32
<sup>b</sup> חזרה ש' למחוייב וכ' the oath goes back to (is thrown again on) him who is bound to make it. Ib. כל המחוייב ש' וכ' whoever would, according to law, be bound to make oath, and is disqualified from doing so, must pay; a. fr.—שְׁבוּעַת ביטוי, ש' שוא, ש' היסת, ש' הפקדון &c., v. בִּיטוּי, שָׁוְא, הֶיסֵּת, פִּקָּדוֹן, &c.—שבועת הדיינין the oath imposed by the judges, legal oath. Ib. VI, 1 Y. a. Bab. (Mish. 
<italic>pl.</italic>); a. fr.—
<italic>Pl.</italic> שְׁבוּעוֹת. Ib. I, 1 ש' שתים שהן ארבע the transgressions in cases of oaths are of two classes, subdivided into four. Ib. 25
<sup>a</sup> חומר בנדריס מבש' וכ' there are restrictions in vows which do not apply to oaths &c.; שהש' חלות וכ' inasmuch as oaths may refer to things unsubstantial as well as to things substantial; Tosef. Ned. I, 5; a. fr.—
<italic>Sh’buoth</italic>, name of a treatise, of the Order of N’ziḳin, of Misnah, Tosefta, Talmud Babli a. Y’rushalmi.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U00138">
<head-word>שְׁבִיתָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (שָׁבַת) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>resting, making a day station</italic> esp. over the Sabbath.</definition>
<notes> Maasr. II, 3 עד שהוא מגיע למקום הש' until he reaches a place where he intends to rest, contrad. to לינה night lodging. Y. ib. 49
<sup>d</sup> top, v. לִינָה.—Esp. 
<italic>appointing a place to be the centre of Sabbath movements, Sabbath camp</italic> (from which one is allowed to walk two thousand cubits in every direction). Erub. IV, 7 מי שבא … שְׁבִיתָתִי תחתיו if one is on the road (on Friday) at nightfall, and recognizing a tree or a fence (at a distance) says, my Sabbath rest be under it; שביתתי בעיקרו my Sabbath camp be at its root. Ib. 8 שביתתי במקומי my Sabbath centre be where I am now. Ib. 45
<sup>b</sup> חפצי הפקר קונין ש' objects which have no owner acquire a Sabbath centre of their own (and he who finds them has to be guided in carrying them by the place where he found them). Ib. חפצי הנכרי אינן קונין ש' objects belonging to a gentile have no Sabbath centre, i.e. if they come from outside on the Holy Day, the recipient may carry them 
<pgbrk id="pg1515" />the distances which he himself is permitted to walk; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>observing the Sabbath, abstention from labor</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. XVI, 6 (121
<sup>a</sup>) מפני שאין שְׁבִיתָתוֹ עליך Y. ed. (Mish. a. Bab. ed. עליהן, Ms. M. עלינו) because his (the gentile’s) Sabbath rest is no concern of thine (of theirs, the Jews’ for whom he acts; of ours); ib. מפני ששביתתו עליך because his (the minor’s) observance of the Sabbath is thy (their, our) concern. Y. ib. V, 7
<sup>b</sup> bot. שהוא מצוה על שְׁבִיתַת בהמתו כמוהו for man is commanded to let his cattle rest as well as himself. Y. Erub. III, 21
<sup>a</sup> אינו יכול להביאו דרך ש' he cannot bring it home in a manner consistent with the observance of the Sabbath; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> = שְׁבוּת 
<italic>an act forbidden on the Sabbath by rabbinical law</italic>, but permissible in the Temple.</definition>
<notes>—
<plural-form>Pl. שְׁבִיתוֹת</plural-form>. Ib. X, end, 26
<sup>d</sup> (ref. to Mish. X, 11—15) משביתה אחת למדו ש' הרבה from the permissibility of one act, we learn the permissibility of many more, v. צַבְתָּא.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
